arguments.description: Update S1761 ledger hashes via string replace
arguments.command:
$p='AUDIT_LEDGER.md'; $t=Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $p; $old1="- File: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1761DMStackSmallnessActual.lean` (475 lines,

  22179 bytes, SHA256 538ED9D32495A5E089AD47C74ADEDF488118F55F8D222713A3682D1D3CF8DCBC)."; $old2='- Olean: 816744 bytes, SHA256 F907740077957C5D6125C115E607C8D77E497E3EB90E3341CF2EA97FDB6DB5F1.'; $new2='- Olean: 817032 bytes, SHA256 C06616D4C47BCB4E0849E6E53368D667C4E107B7993C3348DC3576FD2D140F58.'; if($t.Contains($old1)){ $t=$t.Replace($old1,$new1) } else { Write-Output 'old1 not found' }; if($t.Contains($old2)){ $t=$t.Replace($old2,$new2) } else { Write-Output 'old2 not found' }; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p), $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
